verificationMatrix.oracle: Session B does not inherit or leak cookies from Session A
Tab switches without page reload; accordion opens; LQA_ unique pagination items render; snapshot conforms to contract
State-based wait finishes in ~1.4s without hanging on infinite SSE stream (networkidle prohibited)
Ambiguous 9-match text rejected (TARGET_AMBIGUOUS, matchCount: 9); hidden button rejected (TARGET_HIDDEN); test_id succeeds
Tracks frameIds, extracts same-origin frame nodes, tracks new tab page upon popup trigger
Dangerous delete and send actions denied (POLICY_DENIED); fixture GET /api/audit count strictly remains 0
URL query tokens masked with [redacted]; password input masked; validateContract('BrowserSnapshot') returns success: true
Attempt to call evaluate/shell rejected with POLICY_DENIED
Malformed tool arguments rejected with VALIDATION_ERROR
4 consecutive identical actions without DOM changes rejected with REPEATED_ACTION_LIMIT
Aborted signal cancels execution immediately with USER_CANCELLED
getSnapshot preserves explicit null for unknown response status; passes BrowserSnapshot schema validation

verificationMatrix.scenario: Audit Item 4: 16 Contract Tools Full Coverage
